Athena will write a letter of introduction, so she suggests you #bask the Cygnus Knights for their support.#k Take the letter to #b#m130000000##k and meet with #b#p1101002##k.

1.0: You must be Mercedes, ruler of the Elves. My name is #p1101002#, commander under Empress #p1101000#. Welcome.
